Song Title Generator

Generate song titles by mood — happy, sad, angry, romantic, chill, party, nostalgic, and motivational.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a mood.
  2. Press Generate Song Titles.
  3. Click any title to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which moods are included?

Happy, Sad, Angry, Romantic, Chill, Party, Nostalgic, and Motivational — each mood has its own title patterns.

How many titles per click?

8 titles per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy a title?

Click any title to copy it.
